verdict.rationale: gstack's skills produce AI-generated analysis and suggestions from the user's own artifacts. Code review analyzes the diff for structural issues, design review rates each dimension and explains what a 10 looks like, and QA produces health scores and a ship-readiness summary. The 'data' it covers is code, plans and session learnings rather than general business or user data. missing for 10: insights over arbitrary user/business datasets, any dashboard-style insight surface, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Analyzes diff against the base branch for SQL safety, LLM trust boundary violations, conditional side effects, and other structural issues.
Rates each dimension 0-10, explains what a 10 looks like, fixes the plan.
Produces contract outcomes or browser health scores, fix evidence, and a ship-readiness summary.
Review, search, prune, and export what gstack has learned across sessions.
Pushes back on your framing, challenges premises, generates implementation alternatives.
